## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (75%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Normal · Careful review
Invasive risk is 0%, but the 90% conformal set includes Normal (24%) and all neighbors are Normal [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 75%, Normal 24%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Favors Benign; non-invasive |
| Conformal set | Benign, Normal (90% coverage, alpha 10%) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability; 30th OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical image quality |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (same top class) | Independent models match each other |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (all 5 Normal, 92%–94% similarity) [F5] | Nearest neighbors all Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1, 4) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.89 contribution), failed AI spot check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical infiltration score (-0.10; -0.62 contribution; 19/20 spot check) [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (-0.57 contribution; 18/20 spot check; caption inconsistent) [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.24 contribution; 20/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Nuclear size and shape** (regions 5, 6, 7) · context · Small mean area (43.9 µm², 0th percentile) [F7]; 90th-percentile size/shape variation [F8] [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.0114 drop, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); top concept (normal lobules, 0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is Normal (24% probability): all 5 nearest neighbors are Normal, differing mainly in lymphocytes and stroma.
- High nuclear size and shape variation (90th percentile, regions 5–7) or region 10 ductal score reflect true atypia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8**: Distinguish benign lesion from normal lobules, stroma, and lymphocytic infiltrate.
2. **Regions 5, 6, 7**: Inspect epithelial nuclei given 90th-percentile size and shape variation.
3. **Regions 3, 6, 9, 10**: Confirm benign tubules and exclude duct-confined atypia in region 10.
